# Türkiye Energy Intelligence Platform

Official open-source project page for EnerjiNabız AI by Faramarz Kowsari.

Core topics: Turkish electricity market, energy data engineering, data quality, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, renewable generation mix, EPİAŞ optional REST connector, TEİAŞ public reports, Power BI and Tableau exports.

Repository: https://github.com/FaramarzKowsari/turkiye-energy-intelligence-platform
Author ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1692-0453
License: MIT
Important: bundled demo data is synthetic and clearly labelled.
